name: Photoshoot GPT: AI Fashion
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Turn your clothing images into AI-powered fashion photos and videos with Photoshoot GPT. Show your collection on models, reimagine existing fashion photos, and turn still images into videos for your online store, marketplace listings, and social media.

Built for clothing brands, online sellers, and creative teams, Photoshoot GPT offers four ways to create content from your product and reference images.

Product videos
Turn a still product image into a video. Choose from available motion options to add movement to your photos and create content for product pages, collection launches, and social posts. Start with a photo you already have, without filming new footage.

On-model product photos
Create a new photo of a model wearing your clothing, starting with a product image. Choose a model, background, and pose to shape the presentation—from a clean catalog look to a styled scene for your next collection.

Model replacement
Create a new version of an existing fashion photo with a different model. Use a photo that already features your clothing and explore other model looks for the same outfit. Refresh your product photos or develop alternatives for a campaign without starting from a new shoot.

Product replacement
Use a reference fashion photo to imagine your own product in that setting. Replace the featured clothing with a piece from your collection, using the reference as a guide for the scene and composition. Explore a new presentation for your product or try different pieces within a similar visual concept.

Describe what you want to create in your conversation, browse visual options, and choose the direction for your shoot. Your saved products, uploaded images, and generated photos and videos are also available in your Photoshoot GPT website account, so you can continue working across both.

Supports English, Turkish, Spanish, and Portuguese. Requires a Photoshoot GPT account.
